reviews.decision_reason: The selection step preserves all supplied demand-bearing rows in the assigned corpus, including the explicit fallback records, without introducing unrelated candidates or dropping visible contradictory/missing evidence.

The normalization step retains only the allowed record identifiers, preserves the supplied need/source fields, applies the bounded eight-row window, and does not add demand claims beyond the provided corpus.

The provenance assembly deterministically ranks the normalized records by demand_score descending with record_id tie-breaks, producing the evidence_sources handoff used by the downstream recommendation. No unrelated or generic keyword-only candidates are introduced.
